title: Day Land Tour Bartolomé
highlight:
• Bartolome is a volcanic islet located off the east coast of Santiago Island.
• 6:30 am leave the hotel.
• The island has one of the most beautiful landscapes in the archipelago.
• It has a volcanic cone that is easy to climb due to stairs and handrail. A grand view of other islands is seen from the top of the cone.
• The Pinnacle Rock is the distinctive characteristic of this island, and the most representative landmark of the Galapagos.
• Wildlife – Land: Lava Herons, Sally Light-foot Crabs, Galapagos Hawks, Lava Cacti.
Marine Wildlife: Sea Lions, Galapagos Penguins, Marine Iguanas, Galapagos Sharks, White-tip Sharks, Sea Turtles, Rays, Pelagic and Reef Fish.
• Difficulty Level: Moderate – some hiking – slope.
• Activities: Hiking, Snorkeling, Swimming.
include:
• Bilingual Professional Guide.
• Transportation – pick up/ drop off at hotel.
• Snorkeling equipment.
• Lunch

title: Tour to the Tunnels – Isabela Island
highlight:
The Tunnels is a lava tube formation where you can go snorkeling and take a short walk (800 meters long). When snorkeling in the lava tube, you can see sea horses and turtles. During the walk sea marine iguanas, sea lions, and blue footed boobies can be observed .
Week 1
7:30 am departure time
13:00 back to Puerto Villamil
Week 2
11 am departure
17:00 back to Puerto Villamil
During the walking tour frigate birds, blue footed boobies, marine iguanas, and sea lions can be seen.
Snorkelers can view sharks, rays, sea turtles, and tropical fish.
Lunch served aboard the boat.
include:
Bilingual Professional Guide.
Snorkeling equipment.
Box Lunch

title: Day Land Tour Santa Cruz
highlight:
• Highland tour includes observation of one of the largest species of giant tortoises that can be seen in the wild.
• Visitors tour inside lava tubes created by lava flowing to the ocean.
• Stop to view the Twin Craters.
• Afternoon tour to the German Beach if time permits.
include:
• Bilingual Professional Guide.
• Transportation – pick up/ drop off at hotel.
• Entrance fee to a private farm to view tortoises.
• Boat transportation fee to German Beach.
• Lunch at private farm

title: Day Snorkeling at Pinzon Island and landing on Santa Cruz tour
highlight:
• This is a full day tour (7 to 8 hours)
• Landing is not allowed.
• Pinzon is a great snorkeling site.
• Snorkelers can view sea lions, sea turtles, reef sharks, rays, and tropical fish.
• Land and explore a beach on Santa Cruz Island.
• Lunch served aboard the boat.
include:
• Bilingual Professional Guide.
• Transportation – pick up/ drop off at hotel.
• Snorkeling equipment.
• Box Lunch.

title: Day Land Tour North Seymour
highlight:
• The island is home to some of Galapagos birds such as blue- footed boobies
• It hosts one of the largest populations of magnificent frigatebirds.
• North Seymour has a visitor trail of approximately 2 kilometers in length crossing the island.
• Wildlife – Land: Blue-Footed Boobies, Frigatebirds, Colonies of Sea Lions, Marine Iguanas, Land Iguanas (occasionally), Swallow-tailed Gulls, Red-billed Tropicbirds and Nazca Boobies (occasionally).
Marine Wildlife: White-tip Sharks, Galapagos Sharks, Rays, Pelagic and Reef Fish.
• Difficulty Level: Moderate – some hiking over unpathed and rocky trails. The total distance of the trail is 2 miles.
• Activities: Hiking, Snorkeling Swimming
include:
• Bilingual Professional Guide.
• Transportation – pick up/ drop off at hotel.

title: Isabela Island All Inclusive
highlight:

Day 1: In the afternoon, travel by speed boat from Puerto Ayora, Santa Cruz to Puerto Villamil, Isabela Island. Check in at hotel and visit the Flamingo Lagoon in the wetlands and go walking or swimming on the beach.

Day 2: Take the boat to Tunnels tour and back to Puerto Villamil (week 1, 7:30 am, week 2, 11 am).  

Day 3: 7:30 am take the boat to Tintoreras (walking)and Turtle Rock (snorkeling) and back to Puerto Villamil at 1pm. Leave for Santa Cruz at 3pm.

title: 5 Days Cruise
description:
The completely renovated exclusive cruise will transport you to the most breathtaking locations and enable you to explore the hidden wonders of the Galapagos Islands. Experience a world-class adventure surrounded by giant tortoises, land iguanas, Darwin's finches, blue-footed boobies, Galapagos hawks, and much more, all in one place
ITINERARY
Day Time Location
Saturday PM Santa Cruz: Bachas Beach
Sunday AM Bartolome: Bartolome

Monday AM Plazas: South Plazas
PM Santa Fe: Santa Fe
Tuesday AM San Cristobal: Witch Hill
PM San Cristobal: Pitt Point
Wednesday AM San Cristobal: Highlands
Download Itinerary

ACTIVITIES

Snorkeling Kayak Panga Ride Species Hiking Paddle board Snorkeling

Explore the mesmerizing underwater world of the Galapagos Islands through our led snorkeling activities. Our guides will take you to the best spots to observe and interact with the unique marine life, ensuring an unforgettable experience.

Kayak

Experience the beauty of the Galapagos Islands with our kayaking adventure. Paddle through the crystal-clear waters and explore the stunning marine life. It’s an adventure that will leave nature enthusiasts in awe.

Panga Ride

Embark on a thrilling panga ride and discover the enchanting islands while observing the diverse marine life in their natural habitat. Our expert guides ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for all.

Species

Amaze yourself as you step foot on the Galapagos Islands, home to some of the planet’s most breathtaking biodiversity. As they roam freely in their natural habitat, you can get close to magnificent creatures like marine iguanas, giant tortoises, and blue-footed boobies.

Hiking

Explore the wonders of the Galapagos Islands on foot with our exhilarating hiking adventure. Involve yourself in nature and cross scenic trails watching breathtaking flora and fauna.

Paddle board

Experience the stunning beauty of the Galapagos coasts with our paddleboarding activity. Not only will you get a workout, but you’ll also enjoy breathtaking views of the islands. It’s the perfect adventure for nature lovers looking to explore the archipelago’s aquatic wonders.

 

Facilities

Living Room Al Fresco Lounge Dinning Room Living Room

Relax and unwind in our elegant Living Room. The perfect place to enjoy time at sea with cruise mates, surrounded by style and comfort.

Al Fresco Lounge

Soak up the sunlight and breathtaking panoramic views as you relax, stargaze, or simply enjoy the cool seaside air from our Sun Deck. The perfect location to embed the luxury that is in nature.

Dinning Room

Submerge yourself in an elegant atmosphere as you savor the exceptional cuisine prepared by our expert chefs. A perfect setting for an unforgettable culinary journey to indulge in.

title: 6 Day Adventure
description:
Day 1: Airport pick up. Visit the Chatos Reserve and view giant tortoises in their natural habitat. Includes
lunch in the Highlands at a private ranch.
Day 2: Hike to Tortuga Bay Beach to enjoy sunbathing, exploring and snorkeling. View sea turtles and
other sea creatures plus a population of iguanas. Optional return to Puerto Ayora via boat.
After lunch, take a tour of Charles Darwin Research station.
Day 3: Boat trip to North Seymour to walk through the nesting areas of blue footed boobies and frigate birds.
Day 4 : Snorkel at Pinzon Island.
Day 5:  Snorkeling tour to Santa Fe Island / Landing on a beach on Santa Cruz
Day 6: View the twin craters and transfer to the airport.

title: 5 Days Cruise
description:
Welcome to an unforgettable adventure in the Galapagos Islands. Experience exceptional service and personalized attention as you relax in a comfortable, exclusive, and sophisticated atmosphere. Let us guide you on an outstanding adventure to this dream destination.

ITINERARY A
TuesdayPM:San Cristobal: Lobos Island
WednesdayAM:Española: Gardner Bay / Gardner Islet / Osborn Islet
 PM:Española: Suarez Point
ThursdayAM:Floreana: Post Office Bay
 PM:Floreana: Cormorant Point / Devil's Crown
FridayAM:Santa Fe: Santa Fe
 PM:Plazas Sur: South Plaza
SaturdayAM:Santa Cruz: Charles Darwin Station

ACTIVITIES

Snorkeling Kayak Panga Ride Species Hiking Paddle board Snorkeling

Explore the mesmerizing underwater world of the Galapagos Islands through our led snorkeling activities. Our guides will take you to the best spots to observe and interact with the unique marine life, ensuring an unforgettable experience.

Kayak

Experience the beauty of the Galapagos Islands with our kayaking adventure. Paddle through the crystal-clear waters and explore the stunning marine life. It’s an adventure that will leave nature enthusiasts in awe.

Panga Ride

Embark on a thrilling panga ride and discover the enchanting islands while observing the diverse marine life in their natural habitat. Our expert guides ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for all.

Species

Amaze yourself as you step foot on the Galapagos Islands, home to some of the planet’s most breathtaking biodiversity. As they roam freely in their natural habitat, you can get close to magnificent creatures like marine iguanas, giant tortoises, and blue-footed boobies.

Hiking

Explore the wonders of the Galapagos Islands on foot with our exhilarating hiking adventure. Involve yourself in nature and cross scenic trails watching breathtaking flora and fauna.

Paddle board

Experience the stunning beauty of the Galapagos coasts with our paddleboarding activity. Not only will you get a workout, but you’ll also enjoy breathtaking views of the islands. It’s the perfect adventure for nature lovers looking to explore the archipelago’s aquatic wonders.

 

Facilities

Living Room Sun Deck Al Fresco Lounge Dinning Room Bar Living Room

Relax and unwind in our elegant Living Room. The perfect place to enjoy time at sea with cruise mates, surrounded by style and comfort.

Sun Deck

Soak up the sunlight and breathtaking panoramic views as you relax, stargaze, or simply enjoy the cool seaside air from our Sun Deck. The perfect location to embed the luxury that is in nature.

Al Fresco Lounge

Soak up the sunlight and breathtaking panoramic views as you relax, stargaze, or simply enjoy the cool seaside air from our Sun Deck. The perfect location to embed the luxury that is in nature.

Dinning Room

Submerge yourself in an elegant atmosphere as you savor the exceptional cuisine prepared by our expert chefs. A perfect setting for an unforgettable culinary journey to indulge in.

Bar Enjoy the lively atmosphere and socialize with fellow travelers as you sip your favorite beverage or one of our exquisite cocktail creations.

CABINS

Double Matrimonial Twin Cabin Bathroom Balcony Double Matrimonial

Our spacious double staterooms with ample balconies are designed to offer an elegant and comfortable accommodation experience, with a luxurious king-size bed, large windows providing breathtaking views of the Galapagos Islands, and a private bathroom with premium toiletries.

Twin Cabin

Our twin cabins offer an elegant and comfortable hosting experience, featuring two cozy single beds, a private bathroom, air conditioning, and ample balconies to ensure a perfect night of rest. Enjoy all the amenities you need to experience first-class comfort on the high seas.

Bathroom

Our bathrooms are equipped with premium utilities, including plush towels, toiletries, and a hair dryer.

Balcony

Embark on a journey to the Galapagos Islands aboard our luxury yacht, where every cabin boasts a private balcony for you to enjoy. With the exception of Cabin 1, which is shared, each spacious accommodation offers stunning views of the pristine waters and rugged landscapes.

Cuisine

Chef Food Drinks Chef

Specialized Chef

Our chef is an experienced professional that will prepare

the most exquisite traditional local and international dishes.  

Be prepared to taste some of the most delicious meals on board.

We follow the most strict sanity protocols to prepare all meals.

Food

Savor the world-class cuisine on board our luxury cruise, where the world’s flavors meet the wonders of the sea. From exotic seafood to sumptuous meats and decadent desserts, each dish is a work of art, meticulously crafted to exceed your every expectation.

Drinks

Nourish in our handpicked selection to suit every taste and preference. We have everything you need to quench your thirst and elevate your onboard experience. Our talented bartenders are dedicated to crafting the perfect drink for you, with every sip promising a moment of pure pleasure and satisfaction.

title: Day Land Tour  South Plaza
highlight:
•	South Plaza is a small island off the east coast of Santa Cruz. 
•	This walking tour is rated moderate difficulty due to the rocky terrain on one side of the island. 
•	Habitat of Galapagos Giant Land Iguanas, red billed tropic birds, and swallow-tailed gulls,
•	Home of a large sea lion colony. 
•	Depending on the season, the Sesuvium ground vegetation changes its color from intense green in the rainy season to red in the dry season
